title: README.md misdescribes the tooling that touches keys and gates: it says the sepolia network signs with PRIVATE_KEY, calls the two broken scripts Sepolia bootstrap helpers, says the Mythril gate fails on any Medium+ issue, and its counts (one fork file, 33 env variables) are stale

evidence.note: "the existing sepolia network entry continues to use PRIVATE_KEY"; hardhat.config.ts:51-59 uses DEPLOY_PRIVATE_KEY

FakeToken "used for Sepolia bootstrap"; addLiquidity.ts and deploySepoliaTest.ts "are Sepolia bootstrap helpers": both cannot load and would target ALCHEMY_URL (documented mainnet) with the bot key (AUD-SCRIPTS-001)
Mythril gate "exits non-zero on any new Medium or High issue" (also :113, :433, :489): it exits 0 on an empty or missing issue list without checking success (AUD-CONTRACTS-003)
fork project "1 file"; the base has 9 test/fork/*.test.ts files (git ls-tree)
".env.example documents the 33 supported variables"; the base .env.example has 145 keys

sibling_sites_checked: README sections on deploy, scripts, CI and env (:105-145, :200-230, :455-510). Runbooks under docs/ are out of this slice. Statements about src behaviour are left to the src slices.
severity_rationale: S3, misleading: an operator following the README could run a "Sepolia helper" that actually targets mainnet with the trading wallet (today it cannot load), and could rely on a CI gate that can pass without analysis.
recommendation: Phase 31 (docs): correct these statements after the Phase 29/30 changes (scripts removed or rebuilt, deploy key, Mythril gate), and generate counts instead of hand-writing them.
